name: SIMONA Aktiengesellschaft
summary: SIMONA Aktiengesellschaft develops, manufactures, and markets a range of semi-finished thermoplastics, pipes, and fittings as well as profiles worldwide. The company offers sheets, win-wall sheets, welding rods, pipes, fittings, flanges, valves, solid rods, hollow rods, U-profiles and square pipes, and customized solutions. It provides rental of welding machine; accessories for heated tool butt and electrofusion socket welding; equipment for electrofusion welding; integral electrofusion welding under SIMOFUSE brand name; stripping tools for SPC RC line pipes; and silicon heating mats, as well as offers tank calculation program under SIMONA SmartTank 2.0 name. Its products are used chemical process, agriculture and food, power and environmental engineering, mobility and aviation, water management, leisure and health, construction and advertising, and infrastructure industries. SIMONA Aktiengesellschaft was founded in 1857 and is based in Kirn, Germany.
